title: Uka Esplendor Ukax Chhaqt’atawa
intro: Aka tuqit amuytʼañäni: mä almax suma isimp isthaptʼata ukat amuytʼañjam tesoronakampi muyuntata. Aka jaqix qamirïtapax jupanakan wali yatiñanakapampix jikxatasitap amuyasïna, janipuniw chiqpach manq’añanakax kawkhans utji ukx uñt’aykänti. Mä ch’aman profetan arkirinakap taypin sarnaqasaxa, aka jaqix alt’at chuymanïñatak sapa jawsatanakarux janiw munkänti. Jichhürunakanxa, mä jaqin khitïnsa uk uñachtʼaytanxa, uka jaqin jachʼa fortunapax qhipa samarañ utaparuw tukuwayi.
clues: Mä profetan tiempopanwa jakawayta, jupajj qala chuyman markaruw cheqa yatichäwir jawsäna.
Mä ajllit markankirïtwa, ukampis chuymajajj uka yatiyäwit jitheqtjjänwa.
Quri qullqix Diosan kuna kamachinakapat sipansa jukʼampiw katuntawayitu.
Tesoronakajajj wali jachʼäjjänwa, mä chʼamani grupo chachanakajj jukʼakiw llavenak apthapjjapjjäna.
Naya pachpa yatiñ laykux qamirïñax nayaruw churapxitu sasaw jachʼañchasirïta.
Qhiparusti, nayampi ukat taqpach jakañ utajampiw mä iwxt’äwjam uraqimp manq’antatäpxta.

arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فِى زِينَتِهِۦ ۖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا يَـٰلَيْتَ لَنَا مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ قَـٰرُونُ إِنَّهُۥ لَذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍۢ
verse: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qārūn. Indeed, he is one of great fortune." (28:79)
